items.title: US large-cap dividend hike watch: 10 stocks with the longest growth streaks
items.summary: Investing.com -- This screen looks for US large caps (market cap above $10B) with a yield above 2%, a payout ratio below 60%, and dividend growth above 5%. They also need more than 5 straight years of increases. 47 stocks matched, and the table shows the 10 with the longest streaks. A low payout ratio means the company keeps room to raise the dividend again.

items.title: Why Is Lockheed Martin (LMT) Expanding Capacity And Tracking A 75 Year Rare Earth Deal?
items.summary: Lockheed Martin (NYSE:LMT) plans a US$420 million expansion of its Camden, Arkansas operations to increase missile and defense systems capacity. The Camden project is expected to add hundreds of jobs in southern Arkansas, reinforcing the area as a key defense manufacturing hub. The Pentagon is pursuing a 75-year domestic rare earth supply chain deal that could secure critical inputs for Lockheed Martin's weapons programs.
